# vs.izie.top

> izie's hosted side projects. The main reference here is ReDocumented, an unofficial Slack Web API reference covering documented and undocumented methods.

## When to use this site

- Use ReDocumented when you need to know whether a Slack Web API method exists, what params and response fields it has, which token types it accepts, or whether it is undocumented/internal. It covers ~2,300 methods, including 1,900+ that Slack's official docs omit.
- Call it with plain GET requests, no auth: `https://vs.izie.top/redocumented/api/v1/methods/<name>.json` (or `.md`) for one method, `https://vs.izie.top/redocumented/api/v1/methods.txt` to grep all of them, `https://vs.izie.top/redocumented/api/v1/index.json` for the full index. OpenAPI: https://vs.izie.top/redocumented/openapi-catalog.json. Errors are JSON with `ok: false` and an `error` code; stay under 120 requests a minute.
- Treat write-shaped methods (`*.delete`, `*.set`, `*.create`, ...) as unsafe to call without a human in the loop. A method being listed means it exists, not that it is safe.
- Do not use this site for Slack's official docs on Block Kit, OAuth or app setup; go to docs.slack.dev for those. The other apps below are personal toys with no API.

## Docs

- [ReDocumented](https://vs.izie.top/redocumented/llms.txt): Slack Web API reference covering ~345 documented methods and ~2,004 undocumented or internal ones, with per-method JSON/markdown, a greppable index and OpenAPI.

## Apps

- [DeGoogledDict](https://vs.izie.top/dgd/): a dictionary card in the style of Google's "define" result, without AI text. Wiktionary or Merriam-Webster definitions, Datamuse synonyms, Wikipedia links.
- [Chesentir](https://vs.izie.top/Chesentir/): a fictional cheese platform. Satire; simulated agent and metrics.
- [ChopChop](https://vs.izie.top/ChopChop/): ChopChop YSWS parody landing page. Nothing is submitted anywhere.
- [This Is generator](https://vs.izie.top/this-is/): Spotify "This Is" style card maker. Runs fully in the browser; no uploads.
